description: Generate the embed code for a CAPTCHA on a web form plus the server code that checks the token. Providers: turnstile (Cloudflare Turnstile), hcaptcha, recaptcha2 (reCAPTCHA v2 checkbox), recaptcha3 (reCAPTCHA v3 score) and altcha (self-hosted proof of work, no account). Servers: php, node (Express), python (Flask), cloudflare (Pages Function), netlify (Netlify Function) and vercel (Vercel Function), plus two form services that check the token themselves, so no server code is returned: netlify-forms (reCAPTCHA v2 only; with no site key Netlify supplies its own reCAPTCHA) and formspree (not altcha). ALTCHA server code is given for node and python only. The secret key is never asked for: the server code reads it from an environment variable. Set useTestKey to use the provider's official always-pass test site key (not available for recaptcha3 or altcha). Source: https://hopi.co.uk/captcha-embed-code-generator/

action.description: Action name. Optional for turnstile (up to 32 letters, numbers, - and _), defaults to submit for recaptcha3; checked on the server. Ignored for the others

language.description: Widget language code such as fr or pt-BR; empty means automatic. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

server.description: Where the form is handled: your own server, a serverless function, or a form service that checks the token itself

siteKey.description: Your public site key (letters, numbers, - and _). Leave empty for a YOUR_SITE_KEY placeholder. Ignored for altcha

size.description: Widget size. flexible is Turnstile only. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

theme.description: Widget theme. auto is Turnstile's automatic theme and the default look elsewhere. Ignored for recaptcha3 and altcha

threshold.description: recaptcha3 only: lowest score to accept, 0.1 to 0.9. Ignored for the form services, which run the check themselves

useTestKey.description: Use the provider's official test site key, which always passes
